findings.title: Migration body replaced with no-op but still marked as run
findings.body: The data migration function is reduced to a bare return, and the comment points to a 0921 migration that does not appear in this change set. Any environment where 0917 was already applied keeps its old behavior, while fresh installs silently skip the conversion. The dependency chain and the referenced replacement migration need verification, since the comment references a file that is not in this PR.

findings.title: get_environment_info logs exception object in extra and may hit Event/Group DB calls per issue
findings.body: get_environment_info calls issue.get_recommended_event() and get_environment() for every issue in the PR comment loop, adding a nodestore fetch and DB query per issue with no caching. Also the exception is passed as a raw object in logger extra, which is not JSON-serializable for some log handlers. The broad except hides failures entirely.

findings.title: Truncated title can be empty-ish and ellipsis appended to ASCII text unconditionally
findings.body: _truncate_title cuts at 50 chars and then rstrips, but titles containing markdown special characters (e.g. '*', '[', ']') are inserted into the bold link text unescaped, which can break the rendered markdown comment link.

findings.title: Log extra key changed to workflow_event_data but other logs in function still use event_data
findings.body: Changing the logged event_data to workflow_event_data is a correct fix only if the workflow-specific data is intended; however the same function's other log calls still reference the unmodified event_data, creating inconsistent logs for the same event.

findings.title: Analytics event recorded before feature check and with wrong endpoint scope
findings.body: analytics.record is called before features.has, so requests from orgs without the feature enabled still emit the assemble event. Also the endpoint is project-scoped but the event is named as organization-level, and user_id is request.user.id which will fail for anonymous/auth-token requests (request.user may be AnonymousUser with id None).

findings.title: Index access on process_raw_response result can raise on unexpected shape
findings.body: error_ids is taken via response[0].get('error_ids', []) without verifying response is a list of dicts; and query_replay_instance is now called on every request before the feature check result is used, adding a Snuba query for every summarize call even when error context is disabled.

findings.title: fetch_error_details uses zip with events.values() whose order is not guaranteed to match error_ids
findings.body: nodestore get_multi returns a dict keyed by node id; zipping error_ids with events.values() pairs IDs with data by insertion order, which may not match the request order and can attach the wrong title/message to an error ID, and missing entries shift all subsequent pairings.

findings.title: Strict serializer validation now rejects the whole batch on one bad report and logs raw reports
findings.body: Previously invalid fields were tolerated; now any single invalid report returns 422 for the entire batch, which browsers will retry, and the raw report body (including user_agent/url) is logged at warning level, a potential data exposure and log volume issue.

findings.title: Removal of ParameterizationRegexExperiment is a public API break
findings.body: ParameterizationRegexExperiment was exported in __all__ and removed; any out-of-tree or dependent code importing it breaks. The traceparent experiment option is also removed from defaults without a migration path for stored option values.

findings.title: Feature check happens after hook call but summary fetch is not gated by it consistently
findings.body: useFeedbackSummary fires the API query gated by the feature flag, but FeedbackSummary returns null only after calling hooks; the summary request is still made for orgs without the feature when enabled is evaluated differently across components, and the isPending placeholder can flash for disabled orgs.

findings.title: Table widget renders hardcoded empty data behind a feature flag
findings.body: When the 'use-table-widget-visualization' feature is on, the widget renders TableWidgetVisualization with columns=[] and empty tableData, discarding the real tableResults. Any org with the flag sees empty tables with no error.

findings.title: Attribute-key hook now runs its query with stale or mismatched cache key
findings.body: useTraceItemAttributeKeys builds queryKey from makeTraceItemAttributeKeysQueryOptions, but the query function passes no search, and useQuery is not gated on tag.key, so suggestion values for the wrong attribute can be cached and reused across attributes.

findings.title: Writable aggregate fields filtered with isBaseVisualize but then read as yAxes while readable side uses yAxis
findings.body: findAllFieldRefs now reads readable visualizes via visualize.yAxis (single) but writable ones via visualize.yAxes (array) after filtering by isBaseVisualize, so the two sides use inconsistent shapes and writable field references may be silently dropped.

findings.title: Visualize.fromJSON now returns an array, breaking call sites expecting a single Visualize
findings.body: Visualize.fromJSON changed return type to Visualize[]; callers such as updateLocationWithAggregateFields handle it, but any caller that previously used the result directly (e.g. useAnalytics, saved query parsing) now receives an array and will misbehave silently.

findings.title: Keys query no longer passes environment or staleTime/retry options
findings.body: The rewritten hook drops environment and the original query options (staleTime 0, refetchOnWindowFocus false, retry false), changing cache and retry behavior for attribute keys without explanation.

findings.title: Removed 'Type' rows from grouping variant display
findings.body: All variant types lose the 'Type' key-value row and its explanatory tooltips, removing user-facing information about what grouping algorithm was used, with no corresponding test updates.

findings.title: Analytics event name changed from view_html to view-html
findings.body: The trackAnalytics event key was renamed to 'replay.view-html' while the event map and type use the same key but existing dashboards and reports may filter on 'replay.view_html'; the rename breaks continuity of the metric.

findings.title: Gradient replaced with theme background, changing transparent mask visual
findings.body: The transparentMask right gradient now fades to theme.background instead of white, altering appearance in dark theme and inconsistent with the left mask definition.

findings.title: update() sets instance.type from validated_data.get('detector_type') which is never provided
findings.body: The owner update logic is added but the surrounding line instance.type = validated_data.get('detector_type', instance.group_type).slug references an attribute that does not exist on Detector (group_type), so updates without detector_type raise AttributeError.

findings.title: processing_deadline_duration values chosen arbitrarily and drain_mailbox raised to 300s
findings.body: Setting processing deadlines (30s, 300s, 120s, 60s) changes task timeout behavior for webhook delivery; a 300s deadline on drain_mailbox means failed tasks are retried far later, with no justification in the PR.

findings.title: Default autofix automation tuning changed from low to off for all projects
findings.body: DEFAULT_AUTOFIX_AUTOMATION_TUNING_DEFAULT and the project option default both change to 'off', silently disabling autofix automation for every project that has not explicitly set it, a user-visible behavior change unrelated to the PR's replay bulk-delete purpose.
